item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[ellis]).

% Anyone who puts others first or makes time for others is thoughtful.
axiom(s1, rule([or(puts_others_first(X), makes_time_for_others(X))], thoughtful(X))).

% Ellis makes time for others.
axiom(s2, makes_time_for_others(ellis)).

% Ellis does not stand up for himself.
axiom(s3, not(stands_up_for_himself(ellis))).

% Anyone who treats others kindly or acts selflessly has good intentions.
axiom(s4, rule([or(treats_others_kindly(X), acts_selflessly(X))], good_intentions(X))).

% Ellis does not act selflessly.
axiom(s5, not(acts_selflessly(ellis))).

% If someone builds trust, then they have good intentions and respect boundaries.
axiom(s6, rule([builds_trust(X)], and(good_intentions(X), respects_boundaries(X)))).

% If Ellis has good intentions, then he is either thoughtful or empathetic, but not both.
axiom(s7, implies(good_intentions(ellis), xor(thoughtful(ellis), empathetic(ellis)))).

% Ellis either stands up for himself or treats others kindly, but not necessarily both.
axiom(s8, or(stands_up_for_himself(ellis), treats_others_kindly(ellis))).","query":"labelled_explanation(offers_support(ellis), Status, Package)"}
